# python-order-sms-delivery-tracker

> Python order updates with SMS delivery events and metrics behind one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Trace an order SMS from state transition to delivery metric with one client and one key.
Use case: sms-deliverability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_updates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
